summary: evals/backbone.py gains S4 ("the blocks she needs were rendered non-empty") -- a deterministic evaluator reading Nora's own already-emitted nora.prefill.blocks_empty span attribute, no model call.
details: Added NORA_BLOCKS_EMPTY and ContextGrader. StrandsInMemorySessionMapper (what TracedHandler's Session mapping gives you) drops any span that isn't chat/execute_tool/invoke_agent, and nora.agent.prefill.build_prefill's own agent.prefill span is Nora plumbing, not a model-invoke span -- so this reads it off a small independent OTel exporter (_prefill_capture) instead of through the SDK's trajectory machinery.

Case.metadata['must_render'] names which block(s) a case expects non-empty (self_card, peer_card, peer_history, people_in_window, notes, loop_decisions, standing, group_transcript -- nora/agent/prefill.py's own _BLOCKS names); a case naming none is ungradable, not a silent pass.
Verified against the real build_prefill() directly (a hand-built TagContext, no DB/network -- it's a pure function): a seeded-empty block reads empty, a seeded-non-empty one does not.

Corrected a stale inherited claim found along the way: design/evaluation/03-step0-results.md's "<people_in_window> is not rendered at all (fire.py:1122)" no longer holds -- that line is a threshold guard today, and issue #210 is fixed. 10-the-scenario-map.md never repeated the claim, so only that one node needed the note.
Not done: actual must_render Case objects per entry point -- the signal and grader exist, hand-writing the cases is the next piece of design/evaluation/10-the-scenario-map.md's Step 2 port.
